name: Alexandria National Co for Financial Investments
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing)

rows.label: Cash & Equivalents
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: ANFI and TYCN are one issuer filed under two codes. Arab Finance reports 'Tycoon Holding Company, previously known as Alexandria National Company for Financial Investment', and Investing.com carries the same series under EGX:TYCN (revenue -2.13 / -3.63 / 1.21 / 2.27 / 5.42 million EGP for 2021-2025, net income -3.19 / -4.84 / 0.04 / 0.94 / 3.23). The stored ANFI vector is byte-identical to TYCN, so these are TYCN's accounts printed twice. TYCN carries the live row (session 2026-10-04) and keeps the figures; ANFI last printed a price on 2024-07-23 and shows nothing here to avoid presenting one company's accounts under two names
